text:
nina: Uploaded a Figma of a new 'preflight connectivity' step for the Private setup wizard. It performs a couple of non-auth probes (TCP connect, metadata fetch) and surfaces a short "what to try" + copyable commands. Link: https://figma.redwood/setup-preflight (mock). Looking for quick UX + a11y sanity check before we enable the flag.

chris: Nice — love consolidating checks. Quick layout q: inline accordion inside the stepper vs a right-hand flyout with full logs? My vote: inline accordion for fewer context switches.

jamie: Agree on inline for first-pass users. Flyout could be the "Advanced diagnostics" path if they click "View full logs". Keeps default flow simple.

neel: Microcopy: instead of "Troubleshooting details" name the expanded area "Suggested fixes & test commands". People scan for actions, not generic "troubleshooting."

rachel: Docs/ops: We should include both curl and a plain TCP test (socat/nc) and a short line: "Sample Linux commands; adapt for your OS/firewall." Avoid recommending iptables as only option.

chris: Sample snippet we plan to show (will add OS note): ```
# allow metadata endpoint (Linux iptables example)
iptables -I OUTPUT -p tcp -d 169.254.169.254 --dport 80 -j ACCEPT
```
Remember to flag as example-only.

a11y-bot: Accessibility reminders: announce results via aria-live=polite, ensure the accordion button has aria-expanded and aria-controls, and that any status icons have accessible text. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for the spinner.

nina: Agreed. I'll ensure the accordion toggles are keyboard focusable and that the expanded panel starts with a one-sentence summary (e.g., "Connectivity test failed: port 443 blocked").

jamie: Runtime: probes should default to 2.5s timeout and show elapsed ms. Add a cancel/stop button that is reachable via keyboard and has visible focus styles.

neel: Copy tweak for short result line — two variants for A/B test: A) "Connectivity check failed 12 likely firewall or routing." B) "We couldn't reach the service. Common causes: firewall, DNS, or NAT. Expand for commands." I'd test which yields fewer support tickets.

rachel: Also include a small confidence indicator (High/Medium/Low) with tooltip explaining what it means. Keep color contrast AA.

chris: UX detail: change primary action label from "Run quick probe" to "Run connectivity test" per product feedback. And show a small animated state (dots -> spinner -> result) but respect reduced-motion.

a11y-bot: For screen reader flow: after test completes, put a 1-line summary in a region with role="status" (aria-live) and make full logs available in a <pre role="log"> block so SRs can jump to it.

nina: Good catch. Also we'll add a copy button for snippets (copies to clipboard) with an accessible label that reads "Copy command to clipboard" and announce success via aria-live.

jamie: Telemetry: add events `preflight.test_start`, `preflight.test_complete`, `preflight.copy_command`, `preflight.open_advanced_logs`, and `preflight.request_support` so we can measure resolution attempts.

neel: Regarding layout A/B: test inline accordion (A) vs dedicated diagnostics page (B). Metrics to capture: time-to-fix, percent that open advanced logs, support ticket rate.

rachel: I'll draft the help article with sections: quick fixes, OS snippets, split-DNS troubleshooting, NAT hairpin examples. Will mark which snippets are Linux/FreeBSD/Windows and how to adapt.

chris: One more infra note: don't perform authenticated calls in probes. Keep them read-only and low-volume. Also log only aggregated failure reasons (no raw network dumps) for privacy.

a11y-bot: Keyboard test checklist: tab order to Run button, Enter/Space to activate, after run focus should move to result summary, ESC should close advanced logs, ensure focus return behavior is sensible.

nina: I'll update the Figma with these changes and post a short Loom of keyboard flow. Planning to toggle feature-flag "preflight-checks" on staging afterwards.

flag-bot: feature-flag "preflight-checks" enabled for staging at 1871234605.

jamie: After staging looks good, let's run a small internal usability pass (5 folks) focusing on keyboard and copy clarity. Happy to coordinate.

neel: Sounds good. Approve for staging once Nina uploads updated mock + a11y notes. :+1:

nina: Thanks all — I'll iterate and ping when ready.
